headword: {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}
gloss: fee revision; rate change; price adjustment

definitions.gloss: fee revision; rate change; price adjustment
definitions.explanation: The official adjustment or revision of prices, fees, or rates charged for a service or product. Often used for public utilities, transportation fares, and subscription services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There will be a rate change starting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the fare revision, new fares will be applied from next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{原材料費|げんざいりょうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The company announced a price revision citing the surge in raw material costs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (fee, charge) and ⟦{改定|かいてい}→改定：13036_kaitei⟧ (revision, amendment). Used when prices or rates are officially changed, whether increased or decreased. Often appears in formal announcements from service providers, utilities, and transportation companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: notice of rate revision
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to implement a fee revision
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: reason for the price change

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: price increase — specifically means raising prices, while {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい} is neutral and can mean either direction
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: price change — more general term that can apply to individual products, while {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい} implies a systematic, official revision
- ⟦{改定|かいてい}→改定：13036_kaitei⟧ vs ⟦{改訂|かいてい}→改訂：13044_kaitei⟧: both read かいてい, but ⟦{改定|かいてい}→改定：13036_kaitei⟧ revises rules/rates while ⟦{改訂|かいてい}→改訂：13044_kaitei⟧ revises written texts like books
